title: Dubai AI & KHDA Smart School Finder
summary: Dubai’s Smart School Finder pilot answers parents’ plain-language questions with KHDA school data; the makers say that it saves time and report no measured saving.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The ITU account names the Dubai Digital Authority and the Dubai Digital Government Establishment as the submitting organizations, with KHDA as partner, in the United Arab Emirates. The organizations describe an initial pilot inside the KHDA portal and the Dubai Now app. The pilot lets parents search KHDA school data in natural language. The organizations state that the system returns up-to-date school details and saves time. They report no measured time saving. Educational improvements are unmeasured. They state that the use case is part of a larger product in development.
purpose: Help parents find suitable schools through current, searchable information.
system: Dubai AI and KHDA Smart School Finder
developer: Dubai Digital Authority, with the Knowledge and Human Development Authority (KHDA)

ratings.reason: The pilot provides natural-language search across current school data, which the source describes as saving parents time. Better school or educational outcomes are not established.
Better educational planning is intended; no agency-level result is reported.

ai_role.statement: The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.

data.answer:
Dubai's school-finder pilot provides natural-language searches using KHDA school data. Easier information retrieval is reported, while educational improvements remain unmeasured.

Natural-language search and verified source data do not establish that families found better schools, saved time, or obtained places. The entry has no completed-user sample, accuracy comparison, or measured access disparity. Recommendations cannot overcome tuition, admissions, or travel constraints by themselves.

The project account does not separately evaluate AI’s contribution to the benefit.
